name: MediaPlayer
summary: Plays a video or a piece of audio, with its caption: a file this product serves, with the browser's own controls and its captions, or a video on YouTube or Vimeo behind a privacy-friendly poster that loads the remote player only when play is pressed. Not for a picture (use Image), a set of pictures (use Carousel or ImageGrid) or a video that plays by itself as decoration (don't: motion that can't be paused fails WCAG 2.2.2).
a11y: A `figure` named by its caption when there is one. A file plays in the native `video` or `audio` element with its controls (keyboard operable, announced by the platform) and its WebVTT `track`s, so captions can be turned on. Nothing plays by itself. An embed's poster is one button, "Play" and the title, with the length spoken; pressing it swaps in the remote frame, named by the title, and moves focus into it. The length badge on the poster is `aria-hidden` (the button says it). A transcript link follows the player when given. YouTube/Vimeo sources with tracks add a labelled Captions choice including Off, and a plain-text caption overlay. The enhanced player's full-screen action includes captions and their choice. Failures offer Retry; cues are not a live region that interrupts screen-reader speech. A remote source's optional seek request starts playback at that timestamp; a new requestId repeats the action.

keys.action: on an embed's poster, loads and plays the video

props.name: kind
props.description: `video` (default) or `audio`: a compact player with its title above and no picture.

props.name: title
props.description: What it is, in a few words. Names the player and the remote frame, and finishes the play button's name ("Play Planet tour").

props.name: poster
props.description: A still shown before playing: the video's own frame, or a picture for an embed (required for an embed: it's all that loads first).

props.name: posterFallbackSrc
props.description: An embed poster's one fallback address, as Image's single retry and failure label. Default none.

props.name: posterAlt
props.description: What the poster shows, for an embed's poster; leave it out when the title already says it.

props.name: posterTreatment
props.description: A treatment for an embed's poster (IP31), as Image's `treatment`: `{ rest: 'greyscale', active: 'none' }` shows it in grey until the player is pointed at or focused. Without it the poster is drawn as before.

props.name: shape
props.description: The video's own width and height, so the player takes its shape before anything loads. A tall one narrows to fit the window. Default 16 by 9.

props.name: duration
props.description: Length in seconds, shown on an embed's poster (an embed can't tell before it loads).

props.name: caption
props.description: One or two sentences under the player: what it shows and, if it matters, who made it.

props.name: transcript
props.description: Where the words are written out: a transcript page. Needed for audio with speech, and for video whose sound carries meaning.

props.name: label
props.description: The language's own name, as the player's captions menu lists it: "English", "Français".

props.name: kind
props.description: `captions` (default) also describe sounds; `subtitles` translate the words only.

props.name: type
props.description: The MIME type, so a browser skips what it can't play without downloading it: `video/webm`, `video/mp4`, `audio/mpeg`.

props.name: seconds
props.description: Position in seconds, finite and nonnegative.

props.name: requestId
props.description: A different value for each explicit seek action, including a repeat of the same timestamp.

props.name: seek
props.description: Opt-in seek-and-play request, in seconds. Change requestId for every action, including the same timestamp again. Loads the iframe API only after Play or this request. Leave absent for an unchanged poster-only embed.
